games.title: Codename Eagle

games.title: Petz
games.note: PF.Magic's desktop pet series began with Dogz in 1995, letting players stroke and train puppies with the mouse.

games.title: Tamagotchi
games.note: Keychain digital pet created by Aki Maita and Akihiro Yokoi that had owners feed, clean, and discipline creatures.

games.title: Sexy Hiking

games.title: Candy Box!
games.note: ASCII browser RPG whose ticking candy counter and lollipop farm helped spark modern idle games.

games.title: The Impossible Game

games.title: PapiJump
games.note: Early iPhone vertical jumper starring a red bouncing ball climbing endless platforms.

games.title: Scrabble
games.note: Crossword letter-tile board game devised by architect Alfred Mosher Butts in 1938 and trademarked in 1948.

games.title: Pictionary
games.note: Party drawing game created by Seattle waiter Rob Angel, turning charades into quick timed sketches.

games.title: Crayon Physics Deluxe
games.note: Won the 2008 IGF Grand Prize for turning hand-drawn crayon shapes into working 2D physics weights and ramps.

games.title: Farming Simulator
games.note: Debut entry in Giants Software's tractor, plowing, and crop-harvesting simulation series.
